title: Smashed Avocado Sandwich
equip: 1 stainless steel skillet (toast); 1 small deep nonstick pan (eggs, optional)

steps.x: Mash the avocado, lemon juice, salt, and pepper with a fork in a bowl until mostly smooth with a few small chunks. Do this first so the lemon protects the colour.
Heat the stainless steel skillet on medium. Spread the butter on one side of each slice and toast butter-side down for 90 seconds until golden. Flip and toast 60 seconds. Set aside.
Heat the oil in the nonstick pan on medium. Crack in both eggs, sprinkle with salt, and cook 2 min for a runny yolk, or 3 min for a jammy one. Spoon the chilli crisp onto your own egg only.
Spread half the avocado on each of 2 slices. Add the tomato slices and egg if using, then close with the other slices. Cut in half and eat immediately.

notes: For the family: keep the chilli crisp off the child's portion and assemble theirs first.
Make the avocado mash right before eating. It browns within about 30 min even with lemon.
Without the egg, it takes about 8 min total.
Slightly stale bread works best, because it holds up to the mash without going soggy.
